[u][b]Nordiheim foreign news.[/b][/u]

Today the Nordiheimian department of foreign relations and the department of trade celebrated the the successful negotiation and signing of a new large military arms deal with the Empire of [nation]Italian dutch[/nation].
This deal will see cruise missiles and a large amound of aircraft, especialy UAVs, be produced and suplied to the Italian dutch Royal Air Force.

This will secure many jobs in the Nordland region for some time in the large aircraft factories of the companies 'Airgos Inc.' and the state owned 'Nordiheim Air Industries'

[spoiler=[b]The Nordiheimian and The Empire of Italian dutch Deal of 22nd of September 2025[/b]]
[b][u]The "Hawk" Deal[/u][/b]

[b]Arms deal between The United Territories of Nordiheim and The Empire of Italian dutch[/b]
[i]====================================================[/i]

[i][u]With this deal the two nations of Nordiheim and Italian dutch agree to adhere to the following arms deal:[/u][/i]
[i][u]_H____________________A____________________W____________________K____________________!_[/u][/i]

[b][i][u]Military Air Deal[/u][/i][/b]
[u][b]1.a:[/b][/u] Nordiheim will sell 20 units of 'Malingee Cruise missile' with the neceseary support package for the total price of 80'000'000 $ to the Italian dutch.

[u][b]1.b:[/b][/u] Nordiheim will sell 200 units of 'BRD-2 Surveyor - Surveillance drone' with a special support package for the total price of 9'600'000'000 $ to the Italian dutch.

[b][u]1.c:[/u][/b] Nordiheim will sell 30 units of 'Airheim HCH3-2C Hawk Moth - Attack Helicopter' with a special support package for the total price of 3'481'000'000 $ to the Italian dutch.

[b][u]1.d:[/u][/b] Nordiheim will sell 20 units of 'T41 Cr Mob - Military transport airplanes' with a special support package for the total price of 2'790'000'000 $ to the Italian dutch.

[b][u]2.a:[/u][/b] The 30 units of 'Airheim HCH3-2C Hawk Moth - Attack Helicopter' and 20 units of 'Malingee Cruise missile' will be delivered over the next month.

[b][u]2.b:[/u][/b] 10 units of 'BRD-2 Surveyor - Surveillance drone' will be delivered over the next month with the remaining 190 units to be produced and delivered over a period of 7 years.

[b][u]2.c:[/u][/b] The 20 units of 'T41 Cr Mob - Military transport airplanes' will be produced and delivered over a period of 1 year.

[b][u]3:[/u][/b] The tottal cost will be 15'951'000'000 $ (15.951 billion $) and will be paid over a period of 1 year.

[b][u]4:[/u][/b] Italian dutch will not be allowed to sell, give or donate any 'Malingee Cruise missile's, 'BRD-2 Surveyor's, 'Airheim HCH3-2C Hawk Moth's or 'T41 Cr Mob's to other nations or groups without first getting permission from the Council of Nordiheim with the exeption of members of the EEHP or THEP.

++++++------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+Hawk+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++

[b][u]5:[/u][/b] Nordiheim will allow Italian dutch full permission to buy additional parts, munitions and equipment for the puchased aircraft and cruise missiles as needed.

[b][u]6:[/u][/b] Nordiheim agrees to allow for future changes and amendments to this deal should that be needed and both parties are able to come to a mutual agreement.

[b][u]7:[/u][/b] Nordiheim or Italian dutch will have the right to terminate this agreement if either nations do the following:
a: Deny access to purchases, or other items outlined to be available to each nation in this deal!
b: Send aid to, supply, or in any way support enemies of either nations such as terrorist groups, pirates, or nations either signatory is actively at war with!
c: Take or declare hostile action or intent against the other signatory of this agreement!
d: Infringe upon the intellectual property of the aircraft, weapons, equipment or munitions sold in this agreement!

[b] Preperations for an Expedition | Erene2000 | Second Flouesch Republic[/b]

"Muller!"

[i]Gonthier Fuelenger says, approaching Müller with a stack of papers in his hands. He was the new Secretariat of National Defense after Marc Ewen resigned after he was expelled from the Radical Republican Party for supposedly collaborating with royalists and lying about his previous association with them. [/i]

"Fuelenger. You're supposed to address me as consul." Muller says, sighing, Fuelenger had been his suggestion after all

"Chill out muller. This whole republic thing was supposed to make us all equal. You aren't special! 

Anyway. I have the great plan I talked to you about to get us more crude oil. See, there are these islands."

He pulls out a satellite data map of the islands

"They're so irrelevant actually, that I couldn't find a name for what they're actually called. Muller, can you believe that? I don't even think people actually live there either." 

"So what are you suggesting here. Fuelenger" Muller looks over the map before looking back up at Fuelenger, his interest is piqued at least. Especially since Müller had been wanting to create a new source of income before he introduced his National Republic Fund to the Staatsrot

"Well. What I'm suggesting is that. We launch... let's say a small expeditionary force to take the islands and make them a Special District of Floueschia. No people live there, so it's not colonialism per say. And, there is a giant deposit of crude oil. Huge deposit, actually. So what do you say, Muller? Interesting, right?" He said, boasting, handing over another proposal for administering the islands as a Special Administrative Region, which effectively would be a district without its own devolved government and administered directly by Staatsrot. As well as potential sites for oil drilling to begin. 

"Well. Fuelenger, it's not a horrible idea. We won't look bad for this because there aren't people there, the islands aren't in a bad location either...I think we could probably get this through the Staatsrot. What do you define as a "Small Expeditionary Force" Though?"

Muller says curious on how much he's actually going to have to commit to this

"Oh. That? I think the Fallschiermjäger and maybe an Infantry Brigade would be capable of securing the islands. No? Fallschiermjäger goes in first, secures a beachhead on one or all of the islands, then we land an infantry brigade and claim the islands. They can be back before we even cross into Nevonia."

Muller begins to look over each of the documents, Fuelenger waiting eagerly to see if he will actually approve his plan. Finally muller looks up, and then back at Fuelenger

"Fine. You got your approval. Go ahead and call the Inspector General and work something out with him. Ill talk to the Staatsrot about your SAV and Annexation proposal." Muller says, preparing to sign off on his folder

"Actually. Muller. I need one more thing. Humor me. Right? So, the Lavanians?. There...a friendly republic, right? We're going to need a base, at least temporarily for air support and to keep a steady stream of reliable supply going. Let me go to them and ask if they're willing to make a behind-the-door deal."

Muller sighs

"Fine. Go ahead. Just don't get caught. I'm sure you already know what the Radical Republicans would think about it."

__________________________________________________________________________

[spoiler=Secure Communication]

From: Acting Secretariat of National Defense, Gonthier Fuelenger of the Second Flouesch Republic

To: Whom it may concern within the Government of the United Lavian Republic

I am reaching out on behalf of the First Consul of the Second Flouesch Republic, Fredrick Muller

Within the coming weeks, the Flouesch Republic will embark on an expeditionary mission to islands directly south of your country. Given that they are internationally nameless, we are, for the purposes of clear communication, going to name them the "Avalonian Islands". It may come as no surprise to my counterpart within the United Lavian Republic that, due to circumstances outside of my control, the republic currently has no open sea navy within its possession. Therefore, we are requesting what exactly you would demand in return for a quasi-secret military access deal that would allow our air force to operate within your country. Specifically, being allowed to use bases within your country so they may deploy paratroopers to the islands to be the primary Vanguard of the Expeditionary Force. 

Additionally. We are willing to negotiate the purchase of potentially 1 assault ship to ferry over infantry soldiers to the islands once the paratrooper landings have commenced in full. We are also potentially interested in the acquisition of air-to-air refueling vehicles as our current stockpile of said aircraft is quite limited in there numbers and capabilities. 

Respectfully, Acting Secretariat of National Defense, Gonthier Fuelenger

Fräiheet, Fridden, Brout a Rosen.

[/spoiler]
